notes: Cat-form DPS at 60: Shred building combo points (Rake is no longer kept up, see the last sentence), Rip as the 5-point finisher (Ferocious Bite once Rip is already up), Tiger's Fury taken on cooldown for the free energy. The fork's feral_druid/apls/feral.apl.json is the sim-tuned version of this same idea, but it names spell ids (17392, 9846, 13494, 17061, ...) that do not exist in this build's spellconst -- stale from an older client, exactly the kind of drift design section notes warn about -- so p1.apl.json (its minimal Shred-only fallback) is the starting point actually adapted here, filled out to a full finisher rotation with ranks checked against spellconst: Shred rank 5 (9830), Rake rank 4 (9904), Rip rank 6 (9896), Ferocious Bite rank 5 (31018), Tiger's Fury (5217, rankless). This spec stays in Cat Form for its entire rotation. Fix round 3: sim/druid/tigers_fury.go registers one id per level bracket and gives a level-60 druid 9846, not 5217 (the level-25 rank this file names); 9846 is not in this build's spellconst -- the same 'stale from an older client' gap the paragraph above already documents for the fork's own feral.apl.json preset, which names 9846 among the ids it drops for exactly that reason -- so there is no engine-castable id to switch to yet, and 5217 is declared inert instead of renamed. The line is kept: it is the guide's own placement and upgrades itself once spellconst carries 9846. Bear Form is not modeled here: Maul (48480) is the on-next-swing tank ability the engine keys off ON_NEXT_SWING_QUEUE_TAG, but the fork's own sim/druid/_maul.go is underscore-prefixed (excluded from its build) because bear-form tank druid is not implemented yet, so no rotation -- this one included -- can name 48480 today. Powershifting (Furor + Wolfshead Helm energy refunds on shifting out of and back into Cat Form), which the community guide treats as core to Classic Feral DPS, is a talent- and gear-dependent technique the APL value language here does not have a clean way to express yet; left out of the default, matching the measured-simplicity precedent set by mage-frost. Fix round 1: re-verified both dotIsActive conditions against the engine, since an id merely existing in spellconst is not enough (a totem-style buff/dummy split elsewhere in this fork resolves to a nil condition -- see shaman-enhancement's notes). sim/druid/rake.go and sim/druid/rip.go both set ActionID: core.ActionID{SpellID: <rank id>} directly on the spell, and their Dot lives on that same spell object (dotIsActive resolves via GetAPLSpell -> spell.Dot(target), not via a separate aura registry), so dotIsActive(9904) and dotIsActive(9896) both correctly find their DoTs. No change needed. Rotation-accuracy program diagnosis (2026-09-28), inert 5217: this file's earlier notes above believed Tiger's Fury was excluded from spellconst entirely (citing id 9846); re-checked against the pinned engine, sim/druid/tigers_fury.go now models it correctly as a single spell (5217, learned at level 24 -- tigersFuryLearnLevels = []int{24}) and casts fine from level 30 on in this ladder's own run (spell:5217=6.6 at every level 30 through 60). Below level 24 (the ladder's levels 10 and 20) the engine correctly does not register it, but spellranks.json carries it as a rank:0 row (level 24), which the ladder's idLearnLevel deliberately does not level-gate -- the same shape as hunter's Multi-Shot/Rapid Fire (see hunter-beast-mastery.json's notes for the fuller diagnosis of why this is fixed with inert here rather than in the shared spellranks parser: a blanket fix there would also wrongly gate Bloodrage/Judgement, which the engine never level-gates at all). Fix round: not declared inert here after all (that would wrongly tell the level-60 zero-talent smoke test to expect it unresolved, when the pinned engine resolves it fine above level 24 with no talent required at all). Fixed instead with a small, explicit, engine-verified allowlist added to sim/internal/spellranks (singleTierLevelOverrides) and its ladder-side mirror in sim/request/ladder.go's idLearnLevel -- see hunter-beast-mastery.json's notes for the fuller diagnosis (this id and hunter's Multi-Shot/Rapid Fire are the three entries in that allowlist). Rotation-accuracy program fix round (2026-09-28): re-checked Rip and Claw against the pinned engine and found both of the earlier diagnoses above stale -- sim/druid/rip.go already scales Rip duration by combo points (RipTicks = 3+comboPoints, 8-16s) rather than the fixed 12s the earlier notes described, and sim/druid/claw.go already registers Claw per rank (clawSpellID[rank]) rather than one hardcoded id. The Claw fix exposed a real defect this file had not needed before: with no gate, Claw (45 energy) undercut Shred (60 energy) at every level Shred is also known, winning the energy race almost every cast and starving Shred out of the rotation entirely (26.5 Claw casts/iteration to 1.4 Shred at level 60). Fixed by gating Claw on `not spellIsKnown(Shred)`, the same idiom rogue-subtlety and warlock-destruction already use for their own pre-talent fallbacks, so Claw is live only for the level 20-21 window it was written for. See the expected_idle entries for the reasoning on both ids and the fuller before/after ladder numbers. Stealth-opener fix round (2026-09-28): the engine had no Prowl and no Ravage at all (sim/druid, this lane's own report) -- fixed upstream the same way sim/rogue/stealth.go's Stealth opener was, with a castable prepull Prowl and a Cat-Form Ravage gated on it -- so this file now opens a pull Prowling into Ravage for the free damage and combo point, 2s and 1s before the pull respectively, both at their top rank (9913, 9867) the same way rogue-subtlety's own stealth opener names its top ranks. Shifting Power fix round (2026-10-07): Forever replaced Tiger's Fury-as-energy-source and King of the Jungle with Shifting Power (spell 1322605, hotfix-only, absent from the client tables), so the line above Tiger's Fury casts it at 60 energy or less. On the guide build it is unlearned and costs nothing; on a build that spends Shredding Attacks 3 and Shifting Power it measured +26.7 DPS (+10%) over the same rotation without it, while casting it only at 40 or less measured the same and at 20 or less lost 1.3. See design/reviews/2026-10-07-feral-shifting-power.md. Raid-build pass (2026-10-07): Rake is dropped from the rotation. Its client row is cheap (40 energy for 61 up front and 34 a tick for three ticks, one combo point; the engine reads the same numbers), and rotation-search measured the energy worth more as Shred and Rip at both the guide build on the bare character and the raid build under the raid preset. See design/reviews/2026-10-07-raid-builds.md.

engineering_notes.1: Rotation-accuracy program finding (2026-09-28): below level 20 a feral druid has no Cat Form yet (spellconst: Cat Form, spell 768, learn level 20) and Bear Form's own damage kit is not modeled in this engine (Maul lives in the underscore-prefixed, excluded sim/druid/_maul.go), so the only real option for a leveling feral before 20 is the same baseline caster kit every druid has. Previously this rotation named nothing here at all, leaving the level-10 ladder rung at auto-attack only. Gated on `not spellIsKnown(Claw)`: Claw and Cat Form share the same learn level (20), so it doubles as a level check without a level primitive the APL language does not have. sim/druid/druid.go's RegisterFeralCatSpells did not register Moonfire/Wrath at all before this fix -- fixed there too, adding the same registerMoonfireSpell()/registerWrathSpell() calls RegisterBalanceSpells already makes. A residual, deliberately unfixed inaccuracy: NewFeralDruid still hardcodes StartingForm to Cat regardless of level, so the very first GCD or so of a sub-20 iteration still auto-attacks with the Cat Form claw weapon before this line's first cast unshifts it.
engineering_notes.5: Fix round: the engine's Rip carries a fixed 12s duration rather than one that scales with combo points, and this bare build's only combo generator is Shred, which reaches 5 combo points slower than a talented/geared build would -- gating the refresh on `not dotIsActive` meant Rip was ALWAYS already expired by the time 5 combo points arrived, so the Bite branch was unreachable every time, not just occasionally. dotRemainingTime < 6s is the same clip-avoidance shape as warrior-arms' Rend upkeep.
engineering_notes.6: Fix round: paired with the dotRemainingTime rewrite above, this is the branch engine lane 1's report found unreachable under the engine's fixed 12s Rip.
engineering_notes.8: druid.md audit finding 2: sim/druid/claw.go's registerClawSpell now does the same core.HighestRankAtLevel(clawLearnLevels, druid.Level) per-rank lookup Shred and Rake use, with a real clawSpellID[rank] table (1082/3029/5201/9849/9850 at levels 20/28/38/48/58), so Claw casts correctly at every level from 20 on. With no upper gate, Claw kept competing with Shred at every level Shred is also known, and Claw's 45-energy cost undercuts Shred's 60 -- the ladder's own level-60 run (before this fix) showed Claw firing 26.5 times/iteration against Shred's 1.4, starving the strictly stronger filler out of the rotation entirely. Gated on `not spellIsKnown(Shred)` the same way rogue-subtlety gates its Sinister Strike fallback on `not spellIsKnown(Hemorrhage)`.

expected_idle.reason: Ferocious Bite only fires at 5 combo points while Rip still has more than 6s left (the branch above it refreshes Rip instead). Superseding this entry's earlier text (which believed the engine's Rip still carried a fixed 12s duration -- that was fixed upstream, sim/druid/rip.go's RipTicks(comboPoints) = 3+comboPoints, giving 8s-16s depending on combo points, and confirmed still current against this pinned engine, rotation-accuracy program, 2026-09-28): even with that real combo-point scaling, this bare, ungeared ladder build's only combo generators are Rake maintenance and Shred filler, at 40/60 energy with no haste, crit (Primal Fury) or talent discounts to speed the rebuild -- the ~10-11s it takes to bank 5 combo points again leaves Rip (reapplied at 16s when it last hit exactly 5 combo points) with only a few seconds of slack, and the run's own energy/RNG variance consistently lands it under the 6s refresh threshold before 5 combo points are next banked. The line is kept for a geared/talented character (Primal Fury, +hit/haste gear) where faster combo-point generation makes it reachable; a bare dummy simply cannot out-pace Rip's own upkeep, which is a real Classic feral mechanic, not a rotation or engine defect.

Claw is the fallback builder for level 20-21, before Shred is learned. Superseding this entry's earlier text (which believed sim/druid/claw.go had no per-rank registration and so this line was permanently inert below level 58): that has since been fixed upstream (registerClawSpell now uses the same per-rank clawSpellID[core.HighestRankAtLevel(...)] lookup Shred and Rake use), and fixing it exposed a real defect the earlier notes did not anticipate -- with no gate, Claw kept firing at every level Shred is also known, since Claw's 45-energy cost (spellconst) undercuts Shred's 60 and won the energy race almost every time (26.5 casts/iteration to Shred's 1.4 at level 60, pre-fix). The line is now gated `not spellIsKnown(Shred)` (see the priority list's own note on this action), so from level 22 on -- every level this rule's zero_casts check flags -- Claw correctly goes idle and Shred, the strictly stronger filler (2.25x multiplier vs Claw's 1x), claims the slot instead. The fallback yielding as designed below level 22, not a defect.

Moonfire is the pre-Cat-Form upkeep line for level 10-19 (see the priority list's own note on this action for the full diagnosis: no Cat Form until level 20, no modeled Bear Form damage kit either). Gated `not spellIsKnown(Claw)`, so it correctly goes idle from level 20 on -- every level this rule's zero_casts check flags -- once real Cat Form abilities take over. The fallback yielding as designed below level 20, not a defect.
Wrath is the pre-Cat-Form filler for level 10-19, paired with the Moonfire line above (same gate, same diagnosis). Correctly idle from level 20 on for the same reason.

sources.label: Warcraft Tavern: WoW Classic Feral Druid DPS rotation

priorityList.notes: Below level 20, before Cat Form is learned, keep Moonfire ticking -- the same upkeep line Balance uses.
Wrath as the pre-Cat-Form filler once Moonfire is already ticking; see the Moonfire line above for the full diagnosis. Gated the same way, `not spellIsKnown(Claw)`.

Shifting Power (Feral talent, instant, converts 55% of base mana into 40 energy, 16 s cooldown) on cooldown whenever the energy bar has room for all 40, which is 60 or less. Inert for a build that has not taken the talent; no client spell row states its global cooldown, so the engine treats it as on the GCD.
Tiger's Fury on cooldown for the free energy; it costs nothing and the engine gates it on its own 30 second cooldown.
At 5 combo points, Rip once it has under 6 seconds left -- this refreshes a little before the DoT actually falls off, so Ferocious Bite stays reachable whenever Rip still has real time on it.
At 5 combo points with Rip having more than 6 seconds left, Ferocious Bite dumps them instead of capping out.
Shred builds combo points the rest of the time.
Claw is the fallback builder below level 22, before Shred is learned.
